name: calendar
description: Manage and schedule personal calendar events, appointments, and agendas locally
author: locaLLM

function.name: get_calendar_events
function.description: Retrieve scheduled calendar events, appointments, or agendas. Optionally filter by specific date (YYYY-MM-DD) or view all upcoming events.

date.description: Optional target date in YYYY-MM-DD format. If omitted, returns all scheduled events.

function.name: add_calendar_event
function.description: Add or schedule a new event, meeting, or appointment to the personal calendar.

title.description: Title or summary of the event (e.g. 'Team Sync', 'Dentist Appointment')

description.description: Optional details or agenda for the event

function.name: delete_calendar_event
function.description: Remove or cancel a calendar event by its title.

title.description: Exact or partial title of the event to delete
